limitations: SkySat 2018 precedes 2019 baseball-stadium completion and 2024 GNP canopy renovation; these roofs require current footprint/official-photograph overrides.
GEDTM30 is an estimated 30 m bare-earth terrain model, not a local survey or building-height DSM.
FIA 2025 circuit-control positions and 33 garage places are provisional until the 2026 operational map appears.
No dated, georeferenced 2026 paddock/motorhome footprints were found; these must not be invented.
Esri imagery and CIE photographs/maps are private reference inputs only; they are not redistributed as textures.
Historical imagery registration, material-detail texture generation and manual geometry are reconstructions; native source accuracy is not improved by raster resampling.
